# estimated for BOS, DEN, HOU from malter FG%/3PM/3P%/FT% + hoops eFG%

rows=[]
for n,(gp,rec,pts) in hpts.items():
    h=hoops[n]; estimated=False
    if n in B: fgm,fga,tpm,tpa,ftm,fta,orb,ast=B[n]
    else:
        fgp,tpm,tpp,ftp=est[n]; estimated=True
        fga=0.5*tpm/((h['efg']-fgp)/100); fgm=fgp/100*fga; tpa=tpm/(tpp/100)
        ftm=pts-2*fgm-tpm; fta=ftm/(ftp/100); orb=None; ast=None
    twm=fgm-tpm; twa=fga-tpa
    r=dict(team=ab[n],name=n,gp=gp,record=rec,pts=pts,ortg=h['ortg'],pace=h['pace'],efg=h['efg'],ts=h['ts'],
      twop=round(twm/twa*100,1),tpp=round(tpm/tpa*100,1),tpm=round(tpm,1),tpa=round(tpa,1),tpar=round(tpa/fga*100,1),
      ftr=round(fta/fga*100,1),tovp=h['tovp'],rebp=h['rebp'],astr=h['astr'],orb=orb,
      pts3=round(tpm*3,1),pts2=round(twm*2,1),ptsft=round(ftm,1),estimated='yes' if estimated else 'no')
    for k,s in [('pts3','sh3'),('pts2','sh2'),('ptsft','shft')]: r[s]=round(r[k]/(r['pts3']+r['pts2']+r['ptsft'])*100,1)
    rows.append(r)
hb=['pts','ortg','pace','efg','ts','twop','tpp','tpm','tpar','ftr','rebp','astr','orb','pts3','pts2','ptsft']
lb=['tovp']
for k in hb+lb:
    vals=[r for r in rows if r[k] is not None]
    for r in rows:
        r[k+'_rk']=None if r[k] is None else 1+sum(1 for x in vals if (x[k]>r[k] if k in hb else x[k]<r[k]))
labels={'ortg':'Overall efficiency','efg':'Shot-making (eFG%)','ts':'True shooting','twop':'Finishing inside the arc (2P%)','tpp':'3PT shooting %','tpm':'3s made','ftr':'Getting to the line (FT rate)','tovp':'Ball security (TOV%)','orb':'Offensive rebounding','rebp':'Rebound share (REB%)','astr':'Ball movement (AST ratio)'}
for r in rows:
    w=[(labels[k],r[k+'_rk']) for k in labels if r[k+'_rk'] and r[k+'_rk']>=21]
    s=[(labels[k],r[k+'_rk']) for k in labels if r[k+'_rk'] and r[k+'_rk']<=10]
    w.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1]); s.sort(key=lambda x:x[1])
    r['weak']='; '.join(f'{a} (#{b})' for a,b in w) or 'No bottom-10 category'
    r['strong']='; '.join(f'{a} (#{b})' for a,b in s) or 'No top-10 category'
    r['biggest_hole']=w[0][0] if w else 'None in the bottom 10'
    r['best_weapon']=s[0][0] if s else 'None in the top 10'
    src={'3-pointers':r['sh3'],'2-pointers (inside the arc)':r['sh2'],'free throws':r['shft']}
    avg={'3-pointers':sum(x['sh3'] for x in rows)/30,'2-pointers (inside the arc)':sum(x['sh2'] for x in rows)/30,'free throws':sum(x['shft'] for x in rows)/30}
    r['leans_on']=max(src,key=lambda k:src[k]-avg[k])
rows.sort(key=lambda r:-r['ortg'])
for r in rows: print(r['ortg_rk'],r['team'],r['ortg'],r['tpar'],r['ftr'],r['sh3'],r['sh2'],r['shft'],r['leans_on'],'|',r['weak'][:70])
